io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.keys

Interface Keyed

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    GEOResource, SlimefunGuideOption<T>
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AddonItemGroup, AddonSectionItemGroup, BiomeMap, BlockDataService, CategoryItemGroup, CustomItemDataService, FlexItemGroup, ItemDescriptionsOption, ItemGroup, LocalizationService, LockedItemGroup, NestedItemGroup, RecipeType, Research, SeasonalItemGroup, SlimefunLocalization, StatusEffect, SubItemGroup, TagParser

    public interface Keyed
    Java-8 universal port: an own, relocated stand-in for org.bukkit.Keyed (MC 1.12+).

    See NamespacedKey. Many always-loaded Slimefun types implements Keyed; declaring the real org.bukkit.Keyed would make those classes fail to load on 1.8–1.11 servers (the interface is absent there and Bukkit refuses to load plugin-shipped org.bukkit.* classes). This own interface lives in Slimefun's package, is bundled, and loads on every version.
